title: Array Constraints
description: Write SystemVerilog code with constraints: array size < 10 and array sum = 100. Create a class with random array and test it.
hint: Use: rand int array[]; constraint c_size { array.size() < 10; } constraint c_sum { array.sum() == 100; }

title: SystemVerilog Counter
description: Implement a simple 8-bit counter with enable and reset using SystemVerilog always_ff.
hint: Use: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) count <= 0; else if (enable) count <= count + 1; end

title: Simple FIFO
description: Implement a basic FIFO with write and read pointers using SystemVerilog.
hint: Use: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) begin wr_ptr <= 0; rd_ptr <= 0; count <= 0; end else begin ... end end

title: Simple Assert Statement
description: Add a SystemVerilog assert statement to check a condition.
hint: Use: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (!rst_n) valid |-> value != 0) else $error("value is 0 when valid");
